Premium artificial Buxus topiary balls that exude natural charm and exceptional realism. Our exquisite Buxus balls are meticulously crafted to elevate your indoor and outdoor spaces, bringing timeless elegance to your home or commercial environment.

Unparalleled Realism: Our Buxus topiary balls are renowned for their extremely realistic appearance, making it hard to believe they aren't the real deal. Each ball boasts handcrafted, lifelike foliage, meticulously designed to mimic the Buxus plant's natural beauty. The real timber stem adds to the authenticity, providing a touch of nature in every ball.

Easy Planting and Stability: Planting your Buxus ball is a breeze with our specialized stabilizer base. Simply position the real timber stem and base into soil, sand or stones and you're ready to showcase your topiary masterpiece in your display planters, troughs, or window boxes. The stability ensures your Buxus ball remains upright and secure.

Convenience at Its Best: We care about providing you with a seamless experience, which is why the height of our Buxus balls includes the pot, stem, and foliage. No need for any additional calculations – we've got you covered! The width of the ball is precisely measured from the widest points of the lush foliage, ensuring you have all the information you need for a perfect fit. The height is inclusive of the stem and pot.

Versatility and Durability: Suitable for both indoor and outdoor use, our artificial Buxus topiary balls are crafted using high-quality materials, making them weather-resistant and durable. Rain or shine, these Buxus balls will maintain their immaculate appearance, brightening up your space for years to come.

Easy Integration with Your Existing Decor: Planting your Buxus ball into stones, pebbles, or sand is effortless, enabling you to customize your display and create an eye-catching focal point in your garden or living space. The possibilities are endless, allowing you to let your creativity flourish.

Comprehensive Services: At Replica Plants, we strive to go beyond offering exceptional products. Our team provides a planting and display planter service to assist you in creating a captivating arrangement. Additionally, we offer a professional installation service, ensuring a seamless setup for your Buxus topiary ball.

Explore the Collection: Apart from our top-selling Buxus balls, we offer an assortment of other products to complement your selection. Choose from the elegant Buxus spiral, the charming Lollipop Buxus ball, and the grand Buxus tower, all designed to add a touch of sophistication to any space.

Additionally, our range of display planters allows you to select the perfect planter to complement your interior or exterior design scheme.

products.title: Bespoke Artificial Bonsai Tree
products.description:
Bespoke Artificial Bonsai Trees – Handmade to Order

Our stunning bespoke artificial Bonsai trees are individually handcrafted to order and can be made in virtually any size to suit your requirements.

We can also manufacture our artificial Bonsai trees for outdoor use, depending on their intended location and exposure to the elements. Simply let us know where you would like your tree to be positioned, and our team will be happy to advise on suitability and provide a quotation.

How Our Artificial Bonsai Trees Are Made

Each tree is carefully handcrafted using a strong steel frame, which is then covered with foam and expertly shaped to create the natural appearance of a real Bonsai tree.

The structure is then finished with artificial bark and hand-painted to achieve a realistic look, with colours and finishes tailored to your individual requirements.

Lead Times

As every artificial Bonsai tree is individually made to order, our standard production time is approximately 6 weeks.

If you have any questions about the manufacturing process, sizing, finishes or suitability for your space, please don't hesitate to get in touch.

Call our friendly team on 01661 871481 to discuss your requirements and receive a personalised quotation.

We look forward to helping you create your perfect artificial Bonsai tree.
